parole.significato: Agency, establishment engaged in doing business for another.
parole.testo: From Medieval Latin agentia, from the oblique stem of Latin agēns.
Borrowed from Medieval Latin prostata, from Ancient Greek προστάτης (prostátēs, “one standing before, protector”), from πρό (pró, “before”) + ἵστημι (hístēmi, “to stand”).

parole.significato: yarrow, any plant of the genus Achillea
parole.testo: From earlier roman, from Medieval Latin later found in translingual Chamomilla romana, Chamaemelum romanum.
